answer: The system requires each new inlet to solve progressively difficult proof-of-work puzzles timed with block production, while simultaneously maintaining a verifiable reputation ledger. New identities begin as sparrow accounts with minimal privileges, earning upgraded raven status only after demonstrating sustained activity and peer validation over weeks. This dual gatekeeping forces attackers to expend real computational resources and social capital to spawn meaningful sybil networks, making large-scale fake identity flooding economically prohibitive.
